result.stdout:
Description:
  Bumps each PackageReference in opted-in projects to its next available NuGet version.

Usage:
  saucery-nuget [options]

Options:
  -s, --solution <solution> (REQUIRED)   Path to the .sln or .slnx file to process.
  --include-prerelease                   Include prerelease versions when resolving the next version.
  --dry-run                              Print proposed changes without writing any files.
  --bump-own-version                     When any PackageReference is updated, also increment the project's own <PackageVersion>.
  --version-segment <Major|Minor|Patch>  The semver segment to increment when --bump-own-version is set (patch, minor, major). [default: Patch]
  -p, --project <project>                Optional: limit processing to one or more opted-in projects by project name or path.
  -w, --sync-with <sync-with>            Optional: keep each processed project's <PackageVersion> in sync with the specified dependency package id (e.g. TUnit).
  --scan-unregistered                    Optional: Include .csproj files found on disk but not registered in the solution.
  --exclude-packages <exclude-packages>  Optional: one or more package IDs to exclude from being updated.
  --exclude-projects <exclude-projects>  Optional: one or more project names or paths to exclude from processing.
  --versions-behind <versions-behind>    Optional: only upgrade a package up to N versions before the latest. If the current version is already at or beyond that point, the package is skipped.
  -?, -h, --help                         Show help and usage information
  --version                              Show version information
